title: Design System: O Imperador Barber Shop

display.purpose: Landing hero name only. One per page, landing surface only.

title.purpose: Modal titles, card headings, dashboard section titles.

body.purpose: All prose. Inter, constrained to max-w-xl in marketing copy.

label.purpose: Tracked-out uppercase eyebrows, admin section labels, micro-cues.

wordmark.purpose: Stacked 'O IMPERADOR' / 'BARBER SHOP' lockup in header and footer.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modal dialog only, above a black/70 backdrop-blur scrim. The single shipped shadow.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default for hover/active color shifts on buttons, chips, inputs, cards.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Admin sidebar translate in/out below lg.

motion.name: arrival
motion.purpose: Authored entrance: the landing service list revealing as a list, 55ms per sibling.

motion.name: lamplight
motion.purpose: Pointer-tracked radial highlight across the hero CTA's gold.

motion.name: hair-rain
motion.purpose: The landing hero's authored moment. Paused offscreen and on hidden tabs; a single static frame under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single solid-gold element on most screens. Booking CTAs, form submits.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #C9A84C; color: #0D0D0D; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E8C96A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #A8872E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0D0D0D, 0 0 0 4px #C9A84C; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Gold outline on transparent. Paired beside primary for the lower-intent action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #C9A84C; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #C9A84C; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(201,168,76,0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(201,168,76,0.2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0D0D0D, 0 0 0 4px #C9A84C; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled field with hint; border shifts to gold on focus, to red with an alert message on error.
components.html: Usamos só para confirmar o horário.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 320px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(245,245,245,0.8); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1A1A1A; color: #F5F5F5; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,245,0.2); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(245,245,245,0.3); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C9A84C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #C9A84C; } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgba(245,245,245,0.5); margin: 0; }

components.name: Time Slot Chip
components.description: Bookable time in a 3-up (4-up at sm) listbox grid. Selection inverts to solid gold.
components.css: .ds-slot-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 8px; max-width: 280px; } .ds-slot { background: transparent; color: #F5F5F5; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,245,0.2); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-slot:hover { border-color: rgba(201,168,76,0.5); background: rgba(201,168,76,0.1); } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0D0D0D, 0 0 0 4px #C9A84C; } .ds-slot--selected { background: #C9A84C; border-color: #C9A84C; color: #0D0D0D; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Selectable service row: name and duration left, gold price right. Selected state is a gold border over a gold/10 wash.
components.css: .ds-service { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,245,0.1); border-radius: 12px; background: #1A1A1A; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; max-width: 420px; } .ds-service:hover { border-color: rgba(201,168,76,0.5); } .ds-service--selected { border-color: #C9A84C; background: rgba(201,168,76,0.1); } .ds-service-check { width: 20px; height: 20px; accent-color: #C9A84C; } .ds-service-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; } .ds-service-name { color: #F5F5F5; font-weight: 500; } .ds-service-desc { color: rgba(245,245,245,0.5); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-service-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-service-price { color: #C9A84C; font-weight: 600; } .ds-service-dur { color: rgba(245,245,245,0.5); font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Appointment status pill. 20%-opacity fill of its own text color; Concluído is gold, not green.
components.html: Confirmado Concluído Cancelado
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge--confirmed { color: #4ADE80; background: rgba(74,222,128,0.2); } .ds-badge--completed { color: #C9A84C; background: rgba(201,168,76,0.2); } .ds-badge--cancelled { color: #9CA3AF; background: rgba(156,163,175,0.2); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Admin sidebar link. Active is a gold/15 wash with gold weight-600 text; inactive is white/70 warming to gold.
components.html: DashboardBarbeirosServiços
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: #1A1A1A; padding: 16px; width: 220px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(245,245,245,0.1); } .ds-nav-item { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: rgba(245,245,245,0.7); text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(201,168,76,0.1); color: #C9A84C; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(201,168,76,0.15); color: #C9A84C; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Stacked lockup used in the header and footer. Montserrat 900 over a tracked-out subline.
components.html: O IMPERADORBARBER SHOP
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark-main { font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #C9A84C; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-wordmark-sub { font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.55rem; letter-spacing: 0.35em; color: rgba(201,168,76,0.6); } .ds-wordmark:hover .ds-wordmark-main { color: #E8C96A; } .ds-wordmark:hover .ds-wordmark-sub { color: rgba(201,168,76,0.8); }

narrative.overview:
The barber's chair as a throne. The room is nearly black — #0D0D0D everywhere, with cards a half-step lighter at #1A1A1A — and a single warm gold falls on the thing being attended to: the selected service, the chosen time, the price, the confirmation. Nothing else glows. The interface is ceremony without stuffiness: the client is being attended to, not processed through a form.

The system is built almost entirely from two moves. First, tonal layering: black, black-soft, and a 1px rgba(245,245,245,0.1) hairline separate every surface from the one behind it. Second, the gold tint ladder: the same #C9A84C at 5% / 10% / 15% / 20% / 30% opacity does the work that a second and third accent color would do elsewhere — hover washes, selected states, badge fills, focus rings, decorative rings on the hero. Gold at full strength is reserved for things that are true right now: a price, a selected slot, the primary button, the wordmark.

Density is generous rather than efficient. Sections breathe at 80px; cards pad at 16–48px; text runs at 1.625 line-height. This is a mobile-first product opened one-handed from a WhatsApp link, so tap targets are large (40px slot chips, 44px+ buttons) and the layout is a single column until sm, with the barber and admin tools widening into two-column and sidebar shells at lg.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas, gold as the only accent hue
Hairline borders (1px white @ 10–20%) instead of shadows
Montserrat 900 with tight tracking for identity; Inter for everything read
Wide-tracked uppercase micro-labels (0.1em–0.4em) as the recurring formal gesture
State expressed as a gold tint wash, never as a color change to a different hue
Portuguese-only copy; R$ and DD/MM formatting are part of the visual rhythm

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: There is one accent hue in this product. Any new color must be a status signal (green/gray/red) or a tint of #C9A84C. A second decorative hue is a defect.

rules.name: The Tint Ladder Rule
rules.body: Emphasis below "primary" is expressed as brand-gold at 5/10/15/20/30% opacity over black — never as a new solid color. Hover is /10, selected fill is /10 with a solid #C9A84C border, active nav is /15, badge fill is /20, decorative borders are /30 and below.

rules.name: The Opacity Type Scale Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is brand-white at a documented opacity step, not a gray. /60 for prose, /50 for metadata, /30 for placeholders. Never introduce #9CA3AF as body text.

rules.name: The Wide-Track Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is always tracked out — 0.1em for labels, 0.35em–0.4em for the wordmark subline and the hero's "BARBER SHOP". Untracked uppercase reads as shouting; tracked uppercase reads as engraving.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Montserrat states, Inter explains. If a string is longer than five words and isn't a heading, it is Inter.

rules.name: The Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: Anything a client must tap on a phone — slot chips, service rows, primary CTAs, the running total — is at least 40px tall and reachable in the lower half of the viewport.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every raised surface is separated from what's behind it by exactly one 1px hairline. Two nested borders, or a border plus a shadow, is over-drawing.

rules.name: The One Cut Rule
rules.body: The hero is the only place motion is authored. Everything else in the product animates to explain state, never to decorate.

dos: Do express every non-primary emphasis as a brand-gold opacity tint (/5 /10 /15 /20 /30) over black, per The Tint Ladder Rule.
Do separate surfaces with exactly one 1px hairline: white/10 at rest, white/20 for input strokes, solid #C9A84C when selected.
Do give every focusable control the 2px gold ring with 2px brand-black offset — on a near-black page a ring without an offset disappears.
Do pair Montserrat 900 with tracked-out uppercase for identity, and set everything readable in Inter at 1.625 line-height.
Do keep tap targets ≥40px and keep the running total sticky bottom-0 — this is a phone product opened from a WhatsApp link.
Do route status labels and colors through statusConfig, and keep Concluído gold.
Do write all UI copy in Brazilian Portuguese, with R$ X,XX and DD/MM/YYYY.
donts: Don't introduce a second decorative hue. Green, gray and red exist for status; everything else is gold or a neutral.
Don't use a gray hex for secondary text — use brand-white at an opacity step.
Don't add per-component shadows before the elevation scale is defined; the only shipped shadow is the modal's.
Don't stack a border and a shadow on the same surface, or nest two bordered containers.
Don't use solid #C9A84C for anything that isn't currently true — not for decoration, not for large fills, not for headings. Gold marks the selected, the primary, and the priced.
Don't use #E8C96A or #A8872E at rest; they exist only as hover and active states.
Don't put the display size on any surface but the landing hero, and never twice on one page.
Don't replace a button's label with a spinner — set isLoading and keep the words.
